application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Details pursuant to the discharge of Condition 3 (Materials) of planning permission ref. 75930/APP/2023/1526, dated 04-08-2023 (Erection of a single storey front extension to garage and a first floor side extension including 3 no. roof lights. Conversion of roofspace to habitable use to include a rear dormer and two side roof lights and enlargement of existing rear portion of main roof by extending ridge length. Repositioning of first floor rear windows and two new rooflights. Erection of single storey and two storey rear extensions with skylights. Installation of skylights to existing side extension. Erection of front porch canopy. Rendering of front elevation and replacement windows in side elevation.)
